subject: Finalizing MAP and staged economics for Private VPC license
messages:
From: Kate Barnes <kate@cloudnova.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: MAP & licensing for Private VPC / procurement checklist

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with throughput and the KV cache behavior. We're ready to move from eval to a pilot but procurement needs a clear mutual action plan (MAP) and firm economics for a private VPC deployment. Key asks from our side:

- High-level MAP with milestone dates (pilot start/end, acceptance, ramp to committed capacity)
- Pricing model: one-time platform fee vs annual platform fee + committed GPU units and per-token overage
- Discounts tied to multi-quarter commits / staircase ramp
- SOC2 / audit evidence and expected onboarding window for network/VPC connectivity

I attached our procurement checklist (attached separately). Can you send a MAP draft and a proposed commercial structure this week?

Thanks,
Kate
Kate Barnes
Senior IT Procurement
CloudNova Inc

Attachments: CloudNova-Procurement-Checklist.pdf
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Kate Barnes <kate@cloudnova.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP & licensing for Private VPC / procurement checklist

Kate —

Appreciate the clarity. Attached is a first-pass MAP (2027-01-14-MAP-v1.pdf) and a short commercial note. High-level proposal:

MAP milestones (proposed)
- Week 0 (Jan 18): Kickoff + access to evaluation VPC (30-day eval)
- Week 4 (Feb 15): Pilot acceptance sign-off (functional tests + perf SLOs)
- Week 8 (Mar 15): PO for initial committed capacity (3-month committed ramp)
- Week 20 (May 10): Full production ramp to target capacity / final pricing tier applied

Commercial structure (options)
1) Platform fee + committed units: $60k platform fee (annual) + committed GPU hours (discounted unit price).
2) Staged commit with staircase discounts: 10% discount on unit price after month 3 commit, 20% after month 6 commit.
3) No-platform-fee option: higher per-unit price; useful if you prefer OPEX-only.

Acceptance criteria: perf test (99th p95 token-latency under X ms), integration checklist (VPC peering, KMS connectivity), SOC2 summary delivered.

I've looped in Lauren for procurement/legal prep and can bring Monica (commercial) and Dev (engineering) into the thread to lock the platform fee and acceptance SLOs.

Next steps: confirm which pricing option you prefer and whether the proposed MAP dates line up with your internal procurement window.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2027-01-14-MAP-v1.pdf
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: CloudNova MAP — finalize platform fee + acceptance SLOs

Team —

CloudNova is evaluating the private VPC route and needs a MAP and commercial that tie discounts to staged commits. Their procurement schedule is aggressive: kickoff Jan 18, pilot acceptance mid-February, needs PO by mid-March for initial commit.

Questions:
- Monica: can you confirm the staircase discount bands we can offer (3-month, 6-month commits) and whether a lower platform fee with a committed ramp is acceptable?
- Dev: can the engineering acceptance checklist hit the Feb 15 pilot acceptance date given their integration dependencies?

Proposed commercial anchor (for discussion):
- Platform fee: $50,000 annual (or $35k for a 6-month ramp-first arrangement)
- Committed units: 4 x A100-equivalent GPU pool for months 1–3, ramp to 8 x by month 6
- Staircase discounts: 12% after 3-month commit, additional 8% after 6-month commit (20% total)

Please reply with final numbers and any redlines you expect from legal so I can share a clean SOW with CloudNova.

Thanks,
Rishi
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Feb 2027 09:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: CloudNova MAP — finalize platform fee + acceptance SLOs

Rishi —

Thanks. I've run numbers with finance and legal on the staircase approach. Here's a revised commercial structure we can present that keeps us within target unit economics and gives CloudNova predictable ramps:

Commercial (final recommended)
- Platform fee (Private VPC): $45,000 annual OR one-time onboarding fee of $25,000 + reduced first-year platform fee of $30,000 (flex for procurement preference)
- Committed capacity: Month 1–3: 4 GPUs equivalent (committed); Month 4–6: 6 GPUs; Month 7+: 8 GPUs (target)
- Staircase discounts: 15% after 3-month committed PO; 25% after 6-month committed PO (applies to unit token price only)
- Overages billed monthly at defined overage rate; credit mechanisms for roll-forward where applicable

Acceptance / technical gating
- Pilot acceptance: perf test (p95 < 80ms for 1k token prompts), functional regression suite pass, SOC2 summary provided, VPC peering + KMS validated
- Onboarding window: typically 3–4 weeks for network setup, can compress to 10 business days with pre-signed connectivity docs

I've attached a redlined SOW (2027-02-02-SOW-revA.docx) and the SOC2 summary. If legal wants platform fee deferral for invoice timing, we can offer a 30-day invoice payment term on the onboarding fee.

If this looks good, Rishi, ask CloudNova which billing cadence they prefer (annual platform fee vs split invoice) and we'll prepare DocuSign.

—Monica
Director, Commercials, Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2027-02-02-SOW-revA.docx; SOC2-summary-Cloud.pdf
From: Kate Barnes <kate@cloudnova.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudNova Procurement <procurement@cloudnova.com>, CloudNova Legal <legal@cloudnova.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Feb 2027 08:11:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Finalizing MAP and staged economics for Private VPC license

Rishi / Monica —

Thanks for the fast turn. CloudNova is prepared to proceed on the recommended commercial structure with one ask: can we get a 60-day warranty window after pilot acceptance to cover critical functional regressions? Procurement also prefers the onboarding fee + reduced first-year platform fee flow (helps our Q1 budget cadence).

We accept:
- Onboarding fee: $25k (invoice at signature)
- First-year platform fee: $30k
- Commit schedule and staircase discounts as outlined (15% @ 3 months, 25% @ 6 months)
- PO for initial 3-month commit to be issued by Mar 15, 2027

Please prepare a DocuSign with the MAP as Annex A and the SOW revA incorporated. Also include the 60-day warranty language in the SOW. Once we have DocuSign, legal will sign and procurement issues PO.

Regards,
Kate
